trafficvision.label: Object detection & tracking
trafficvision.description: Analyse traffic video with AI, track vehicles over time and count crossings over a configurable line.
trafficvision.problem: How can a traffic video provide an overview of which vehicles pass, in which direction and at what time?
trafficvision.approach: I built a Python app where a pretrained YOLO11n model detects objects and ByteTrack links them across frames. A separate counter records each track’s first crossing of a horizontal or vertical line. The app includes a sample video, supports custom uploads and exports annotated video, CSV and JSON.
trafficvision.takeaway: The video shows an actual model run on 10 seconds of motorway traffic, with 15 recorded crossings. The project has 23 automated tests covering counting logic, exports and the app workflow, among other things. The crossings are model predictions; accuracy has not yet been measured against manually annotated traffic clips.

media.label: Speech → text → search
media.description: Find the right moment in audio and video by searching for meaning, beyond exact words.
media.problem: Long recordings are difficult to search. A standard text search often misses what you need when the wording differs from your query.
media.approach: I built a workflow from transcription to semantic search, with a Streamlit interface. Text is represented as embeddings so that queries can be matched with content that has a similar meaning.
media.takeaway: The project connects speech recognition, text representation and a user interface. The repository includes a sample transcript and tests.

melanoma.label: Computer vision
melanoma.description: Skin lesion classification using transfer learning, with a focus on careful evaluation.
melanoma.problem: I wanted to explore how a pretrained image model could be applied to skin images, and how to evaluate it without leaking information between datasets.
melanoma.approach: I fine-tuned EfficientNetB0 on ISIC2020 using patient-level data splits. Model selection used validation data, followed by a locked test evaluation. Grad-CAM was used to examine the model’s focus on validation images.
melanoma.takeaway: The selected model achieved a validation ROC-AUC of 0.878. The repository includes saved test results, figures and reproducibility checks. This is an educational project, not a clinical tool.

cardiac.label: Nightingale Heart
cardiac.description: Counterfactual chest X-rays using segmentation and generative AI.
cardiac.problem: How can the heart region in an X-ray be modified while preserving the rest of the image?
cardiac.approach: During my work placement at Nightingale Heart, I worked on a pipeline for NIH images. Heart and lung segmentation was followed by inpainting and generation of counterfactual heart regions. SSIM was used to check that the surrounding image content was preserved.
cardiac.takeaway: I gained hands-on experience with medical imaging, segmentation masks and generative models. The project was carried out during my work placement at Nightingale Heart. Original image from the NIH Clinical Center, NIH Chest X-ray Dataset. Source: Wang et al., ChestX-ray8, CVPR 2017.

agents.title: competitor-analysis
agents.label: DeLorean
agents.description: From web data to recurring competitor monitoring with LLM-based analysis.
agents.problem: Manually monitoring competitors’ websites takes time and makes it easy to miss changes.
agents.approach: During my work placement at DeLorean, I worked with web data collection and LLM analysis. The workflow was divided into website discovery, page classification and recurring scans, with storage and weekly email summaries.
agents.takeaway: I worked across the full workflow, from unstructured web data to useful summaries. The project gave me experience with agent workflows and automation in a real-world setting.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Audit
accessibility.label: DeLorean
accessibility.description: Automated accessibility auditing with rule checks and AI-assisted explanations.
accessibility.problem: Accessibility issues need to be both identified and explained so developers can understand what to fix.
accessibility.approach: During my work placement at DeLorean, I worked on a workflow for crawling, rule-based auditing and reporting, together with RAG-style explanations linked to WCAG.
accessibility.takeaway: The project combines deterministic checks with language models’ ability to explain. Automated auditing covers part of accessibility work and needs to be complemented by manual testing.
